wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: A REAL ZERO, DECLARED THREE TIMES OVER, not a gap. (1) Cover line 1 CUMULATIVE reads '-0-' and line 2 CUMULATIVE reads '-0-' -- per the repo zero-glyph ruling a glyph denoting zero IS 0, and the verbatim glyph is kept here in the anchors. (2) Form A (p2) is empty and the filer wrote 'No Contributions' in longhand across the first contributor line -- an explicit declaration, not merely an unfilled sheet. (3) p3 is a SECOND, pristine copy of the same Form A page (its footer also reads 'Page 2') carrying nothing but a slashed-zero in the Amount column at the head of the grid, which is the filer marking the schedule nil rather than a transaction: it has no date, no name and no address, so per the contract it is not a field and no row is emitted for it. Zero rows, side transcribed. The LAST and THIS columns are blank on both lines, so the cumulative cell is the only scope on offer.

expenditures.basis: none -- the schedule is not in the document
expenditures.detail: THE FORM B SHEET IS NOT IN THIS PDF AT ALL, so the side is 'none' and NOT a zero, per the honest-non-scope rule. The document is 3 pages: cover, Form A, and a second copy of Form A -- there is no 'ITEMIZED EXPENDITURE REPORT (Form B)' page anywhere in it, and no statute page either. What the cover DOES say is that expenses were nil: line 3 CUMULATIVE reads '-0-' and line 4 (balance) reads '-0-'. That is the filer's assertion on the cover, recorded verbatim in the anchors, and it is entirely consistent with a nil filing -- but it is not a transcribed schedule, and this record must not present it as one. A consumer wanting the stated expenditure total has it in the module's already-published filing_totals; what is unavailable here is any itemisation, because the page that would carry it was never filed or never scanned.

gates.page_subtotal: The Carr 5-5-PG prints no schedule total and no page subtotal, so the cover is the only printed anchor. Contributions gate: p2/p3 hold zero inked transactions against a cover line 1 of '-0-' -- consistent, EXACT. Expenditures gate: not run, because the schedule page does not exist in the document (see recon.expenditures); the cover's '-0-' is recorded but nothing was transcribed to gate against it.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py not run as an oracle here -- there is nothing to count. Counted by ink on the full 200 dpi renders of both schedule pages: p2 carries exactly ONE piece of ink in the grid, the longhand words 'No Contributions' straddling the first contributor line, and no figure in any Amount cell; p3 carries exactly ONE mark, a slashed zero in the Amount column above the first rule, and is otherwise pristine to the footer. Zero transaction rows on either page, and both pages were looked at in full.
gates.geometry_proof: Not applicable and deliberately not fabricated: no rows are emitted for this document, so no row-band geometry is asserted. The two schedule pages were each rendered whole at 200 dpi and read end to end; the two inked marks were re-cropped at 400 dpi to confirm what they are ('No Contributions' on p2, a slashed zero on p3).
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 (balance at the end of this reporting period) reads '-0-' in the CUMULATIVE column, blank in LAST and THIS. The chain closes trivially and consistently: 0 contributions + 0 sub-$50 aggregate - 0 expenses = 0 balance, with every one of those four cells carrying the filer's own '-0-' glyph. No earlier filing by this candidate is in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain was available to run.

escalation_note: Cover totals block re-read in two 400 dpi crops (lines 1-3, lines 3-4) to confirm all four '-0-' glyphs and that the LAST and THIS columns really are blank rather than faintly filled. The two schedule marks re-cropped at 400 dpi. No amount cells to escalate.
notes: index.csv calls this Craig W Buttars / County Executive / 2018 and the cover agrees: 'Full Name of Candidate Craig W Buttars', 'Name of Office Cache County Executive', 'Political Party Republican', addressed 'TO Jill Zollinger, Cache County Clerk'. Office District is blank -- the executive is elected county-wide, so that is expected rather than one of the county's five known blank-office-line cases (the OFFICE line itself is filled). IN SCOPE (county office). THE DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS THE CHUNK FILE ON DATE: the chunk row says 2018-10-17, but the filer's signature line reads '10/15/2018' and the clerk's stamp on the same page reads 'CLERK OCT 15 18 AM 11:29:20' -- two marks on the page say 15 October 2018. Transcribed from the form and flagged. STRUCTURE: 3 pages, and the third is a DUPLICATE Form A (page 2 of the printed form) rather than the Form B the cover's line 3 points at ('from form B on page 3 of this report'); the report is therefore internally incomplete as filed. This is a NIL FILING -- the filer declared no contributions, no sub-$50 aggregate, no expenses and a zero balance. PRIVACY: the cover prints the candidate's home street address, ZIP, a home phone and a business phone in the clear -- all discarded at read time.
